        Quick facts

        Facts checked Nov. 9, 2026
        Motors and speed
        Any motor size, but boats over 10 hp must run at no wake speed (ODNR).
        Ramps and access
        One five lane launch ramp; the marina has a kayak launch, rentals and fuel (ODNR).
        Normal pool
        Summer pool is 863 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at. No public gauge, so this site shows no live level.

        Sources: ODNR, Hueston Woods State Park; ODNR, Acton Lake Fishing Area; ODNR fishing map.

        How to read this
        • No public lake level gauge. No USGS or Corps gauge posts Acton Lake’s level, so the pool line says so instead of a number.
        • The ODNR fishing map is drawn at 863 ft. Without a gauge there is no live contour correction.
        • No public temperature gauge on this water, so the temp slot says n/a. Nothing is estimated.
        • Boats over 10 hp at no wake (ODNR). Bass 4 a day: no more than 2 under 15″ and 2 at 15″ or longer (2026–27 rules).
        • Bass rule change coming. Today Acton Lake bass are 4 a day: no more than 2 under 15″ and 2 at 15″ or longer (2026–27 rules). The Ohio Wildlife Council voted on Oct. 28, 2026 to drop that rule; from March 1, 2027 Acton Lake goes to the statewide 5 a day, 12″ minimum (ODNR news release).

        Tonight’s bite

        A rule of thumb guide, not a promise.

        How the bite is rated

        The Bite is this site’s own rule of thumb, not fishing science and not a forecast. It adds points from readings already on this page.

        • Barometer, the change over the last 3 hours at the lake’s NWS station. Falling slowly +2, steady +1, rising slowly 0, falling fast 0, rising fast −1. Steady means within 0.02 inHg; fast means 0.06 inHg or more.
        • Wind, tonight’s average NWS hourly speed from sunset to 2 AM (the top of each hour’s range). Under 3 mph 0, 3 to 12 mph +1, 13 to 18 mph 0, over 18 mph −2.
        • Moon, worked out on this phone. New or full moon tonight (or under 10% or over 90% lit) +1, otherwise 0.
        • Water temp, from this lake’s USGS gauge where one reports it. 55 to 80°F +1, colder than 45 or warmer than 86°F −1, anything between 0. It never makes a rating alone.
        • Thunder anywhere in tonight’s NWS forecast makes it Tough, whatever the points.

        4 points or more is Good, 2 or 3 is Fair, less is Tough. A missing reading counts 0, and with no barometer trend and no wind there is no rating.

              Park hours and notes

              Any motor size, but boats over 10 hp must stay at no wake speed (ODNR). One five lane ramp; the marina is on the west side. ODNR’s Hueston Woods page posts no park hours. Shoreline traced from OpenStreetMap, not for navigation.
